description: A gray plastic bin with several clear ice cubes sits on the bed next to a small yellow cup, and a purple scoop or tong-like tool lies to the right. The left hand reaches to the yellow cup, lifts it, and tilts it over the gray bin to dump ice cubes in, then rotates the cup back upright and lowers it toward its original spot while the right hand stays near the purple tool without grasping it.
